newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa JSE extends trading after system failure.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa JSE extends trading after system failure.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) extended trading by one hour on Friday after its electronic share trading system failed earlier in the day.
"We have extended trade until 1500 GMT and we will issue a full statement at 1510 GMT," JSE president Roy Andersen said.
Andersen said trade was initially delayed by five minutes at the 0730 GMT official opening and failed again at around 0800 GMT due to a network problem.
The system was only restarted again at 1245 GMT -- 75 minutes before the exchange usually closes.
